description: Documentation for the HAL interface 'Composite Input' managing composite video ports, signals, capabilities, events, and metrics in a platform. The file provides overview, functional details, API definitions, discovery patterns, state machine, capabilities, and usage patterns.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Describes capabilities of each composite input port, including supported properties, metrics, and feature flags.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents current connection, signal, and video mode status of a port.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Details about current video resolution, format, aspect ratio, and interlacing status.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used in batch property queries, relating property keys to their values.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing each property, including type, read-only flag, and description.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data for metrics like lock time, signal drops, uptime, etc.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns platform-wide capabilities and supported feature flags.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port interface for a given port ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Queries the capabilities of a specific port.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Provides metadata about a port (name, description).

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property for a port.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port for video presentation, only if signal is stable.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for port events like connection or signal changes.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Registers for telemetry/metrics updates, supported when `metricsSupported` is true.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves current telemetry metrics for a port.
